description: The local bug-report store (PianoidCore/logs/reports; the same store as the bug button, the automatic reports and the assistant's bug_report tool): list the reports with their triage state and update a report's status (dev-obuf1). Filing a new report is the assistant's bug_report tool, not a registry command.

commands.name: bug.list
commands.title: List the bug reports
commands.description: Report summaries newest first: reportId, source (assistant / auto / manual), kind (app_bug / environment / feature_request, or the fault kind of an automatic report), title, component, severity, status (open / fixed / wontfix / duplicate) and the resolution (note, commits). Read it before filing a report so you do not re-file one that is already open or fixed; a fixed one names the commit that fixed it.

kind.description: app_bug, environment, feature_request, or an automatic fault kind

commands.name: bug.set_status
commands.title: Update a bug report's status
commands.description: Set a report's status (open / fixed / wontfix / duplicate), severity or kind (e.g. re-class to feature_request). A non-open status needs a resolution note; duplicate also needs duplicate_of; give the commit(s) of a fix (e.g. "Core d99e5a0"). Only when the user asks or confirms, e.g. after verifying a fix with a read or a render.

report_id.description: the reportId or a unique prefix of at least 6 characters

resolution.description: what fixed it / why not / of what it is a duplicate
